note: Page.printToPDF is the print-preview and Save-as-PDF pipeline. Headless Chrome does not open a print dialog for Ctrl+P and does not fire beforeprint for that key event. The Print button calls window.print(), which does fire beforeprint; the PDF for that path is then captured with Page.printToPDF. Occlusion is measured in that beforeprint listener, after the app print fit, with SVG getBBox in user units. Each axis-label box is tested against every point box expanded by the full stroke width and by half the stroke width, and against each trend segment expanded the same two ways. A shared edge counts as an intersection. matchMedia('print') is still false inside beforeprint, so the fit uses the print chart width rather than the on-screen width. The letter textarea is edited to Dear Room manager before each JavaScript PDF.
